posts.text:
The breakthrough that solved Navier-Stokes in 88 hours used 130 billion output tokens. It seems clear that other breakthroughs will be possible, especially as models get better.

However much compute we have, it is increasingly likely that we are going to need more compute.

posts.text:
Weakly General AI achieved (at least according to the criteria set in Metaculus in 2020) & a year before the most recent predictions:
✅Loebner prize was a weak Turing Test, equivalent achieved by GPT-4.5 
✅Winograd passed by GPT-3 
✅SAT passed at 75% by GPT-4  
✅Montezuma's Revenge beaten by GPT-6

posts.text:
Another informal nerd benchmark that AIs had struggled with has been passed: Astra successfully designed a Magic the Gathering deck and then used it to defeat a bot on Arena.

(the deck may not be stunning, but it does seem to be original, and it worked)
